members.name: Murray Art Museum Albury
members.bio: Free regional art museum in Albury, open seven days a week and 362 days a year.
members.hours: Mon–Fri 10:00 AM – 5:00 PM; Sat–Sun and public holidays 10:00 AM – 4:00 PM

members.name: Hume Dam
members.bio: Dam wall at Lake Hume, built 1919–1936, with a sealed 3.9 km return walk and viewing platforms.
members.hours: Daylight hours (dam wall access restricted on some days)
members.photo_file: Full Lake Hume looking towards the dam wall in November 2010.jpg

members.name: ShearOutback
members.bio: Shearing museum and Australian Shearers' Hall of Fame, with live demonstrations at 10:30 am and 1:00 pm.
members.hours: Mon–Sat 9:00 AM – 4:00 PM; Sun 9:00 AM – 3:00 PM (shearing demonstrations 10:30 AM and 1:00 PM daily)

members.name: Hay Gaol
members.bio: 1878 gaol turned museum in 1976, with antique windmills and Australia's oldest known bark canoe.

members.name: Dunera Museum
members.bio: Railway-station museum on the 1,984 Dunera Boys and thousands of internees held at Hay in 1940–46.

members.name: Griffith Pioneer Park Museum
members.bio: Council museum telling how the Murrumbidgee Irrigation Area shaped Griffith, open seven days.
members.hours: Mon–Fri 10:00 AM – 4:00 PM; Sat–Sun 10:00 AM – 3:00 PM
members.photo_file: Bills Horse Trough at Griffith Pioneer Park Museum 2026-04-03.jpg

members.name: Cocoparra National Park
members.bio: Range park about 25 km north-east of Griffith, with ridge walks and waterfalls after rain.
members.hours: Open 24 hours (NPWS lists 7am to 7pm; closes for weather or fire danger)

members.name: Junee Roundhouse Museum
members.bio: Rare working roundhouse opened in 1947, half museum and half workshop for locomotives and rolling stock.

members.name: Junee Licorice and Chocolate Factory
members.bio: Sweets factory in Junee's old flour mill, with a shop, the Millroom restaurant and self-guided viewing.
members.hours: Open daily 9:00 AM – 4:00 PM (closed Anzac Day)

members.name: Bethungra Spiral
members.bio: Australia's only 360-degree rail spiral, built in the 1940s, seen from a viewing platform above the tunnel.

members.name: Dog on the Tuckerbox
members.bio: Monument from 1932, 8 km north of Gundagai just off the Hume Highway, based on an 1850s bullocky poem.
members.hours: Open 24 hours (kiosk and farm shop open daily)

members.name: Rusconi's Marble Masterpiece
members.bio: Miniature cathedral hand-built from more than 20,000 pieces of marble over nearly 30 years from 1910.
members.hours: Mon–Fri 9:00 AM – 4:30 PM (closed 12:30–1:00 PM); Sat–Sun 10:00 AM – 3:00 PM

members.name: Junction Park
members.bio: Park with a 35-step tower over where the Darling and Murray meet, their waters showing different colours.

members.name: Old Wentworth Gaol
members.bio: Gaol built 1879–81 from bricks made on site, open for self-guided visits; it closed in 1927.
members.hours: Mon–Wed 10:00 AM – 4:00 PM; Sat–Sun 10:00 AM – 2:00 PM

members.name: Perry Sandhills
members.bio: 160 ha of shifting dunes 6 km west of Wentworth, where a 500-year-old red gum is buried to its canopy.
members.photo_file: Perry Sandhills near Wentworth, New South Wales 2648 2025-02-16 15-20-50.jpg

members.name: Sea Cliff Bridge
members.bio: A 665 m cliffside road bridge on the Grand Pacific Drive, with a footpath and whale-watching views.

members.name: Nan Tien Temple
members.bio: Australia's largest Buddhist temple, with free entry, gardens and a vegetarian restaurant at Berkeley.

members.name: Mount Keira Lookout
members.bio: Summit lookout over Wollongong, with a cafe, hang-gliders launching nearby and the Mount Keira Ring Track.

members.name: Wollongong Head Lighthouse
members.bio: Active lighthouse on Flagstaff Point beside the Breakwater Lighthouse, giving the harbour two lighthouses.

members.name: Sublime Point Lookout
members.bio: Escarpment lookout with 180-degree views over the sea, rainforest and 17 beaches, plus picnic shelters.

members.name: Wollongong Botanic Garden
members.bio: A 27-hectare garden of winding paths and plant collections, with views from Gleniffer Brae Manor House.

members.name: Stanwell Park
members.bio: Small beach village below Bald Hill on the Grand Pacific Drive, known for hang gliding and paragliding.

members.name: North Wollongong Beach
members.bio: Patrolled all year, with rock pools, good surf, picnic booths and free parking beside Stuart Park.

members.name: Austinmer Beach
members.bio: Popular cove beach patrolled September to April, with cafes across the road and a park behind.

members.name: Kiama Blowhole
members.bio: A rock opening that has thrown spray above 30 m in a south-easterly swell, with viewing platforms.

members.name: Kiama Coast Walk
members.bio: A 20 km coastal path from the Minnamurra River through Kiama to Gerringong, walked in three sections.
members.photo_file: The Kiama coastal walk, nearing Kiama - panoramio.jpg

members.name: Jamberoo Action Park
members.bio: Water park with slides, a bobsled and a chairlift, open on selected days through the season.

members.name: Gerringong
members.bio: Quiet town south of Kiama with two beaches and a whale-watching platform used May to November.

members.name: Shellharbour
members.bio: Waterfront township beside a small harbour and beach, with a visitor information centre on Addison Street.

members.name: Saddleback Mountain Lookout
members.bio: Lookout with clear-day views from Cronulla to Milton, up a winding drive through dairy country.

members.name: Minnamurra Beach
members.bio: Beach ending in a sand spit at the Minnamurra River mouth, popular for kayaking and paddleboarding.

members.name: HARS Aviation Museum
members.bio: Guided tours through working hangars at Shellharbour Airport, with about 50 aircraft and a Boeing 747.

members.name: Minnamurra Rainforest
members.bio: Elevated walkways through rare remnant rainforest, with a visitor centre and the one-hour Lyrebird loop.
members.photo_file: Minnamurra Falls in Budderoo National Park, New South Wales in January 2022.jpg

members.name: Carrington Falls
members.bio: The Kangaroo River drops over 50 m here, with three lookouts, rockpools and a picnic area nearby.

members.name: Macquarie Pass National Park
members.bio: Escarpment rainforest park with the 2 km Cascades walk to a waterfall and pool, and a picnic area.
